statement: For every valid nums, the function returns a result res and res is the maximum of all values S(i,l,h) = sum_{j=l}^{h} b(i,j), taken over all integers i,l,h with 0 <= i < len(nums) and 0 <= l <= h < len(nums), where b(i,j) = nums[i]*nums[i] if j=i and b(i,j)=nums[j] otherwise. No subarray is empty, and exactly one index i is squared.
